title: Fluent Support Pro <= 2.3.1 - Missing Authorization
desc: The Fluent Support Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access due to a missing capability check on a function in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.1. title: GitPython before 3.1.59 Remote Code Execution via Config Injection
desc: GitPython before 3.1.59 fails to safely re-serialize multi-line git-config values during write operations, corrupting dormant quoted values into injected directives like core.hooksPath. Attackers can craft config files with embedded newlines that become live git directives after any unrelated GitPython config write, enabling arbitrary code execution via hook invocation.

title: NLTK before 3.10.3 Entity Expansion DoS via ElementTree
